/* CastUserSnapshotMapper.insertSchdlAtrbFromDaily */ INSERT INTO PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_SCHDL_ATRB ( SCHDL_ATRB_GROUP_ID, DOM_INTL_SE_CD, ARR_DEP_SE_CD, TMNL_ID, ALN_CD, FLTNM, DEP_ARR_YMD, DEP_ARR_HM, PREDC_HM, ACTL_HM, ARR_DEP_ARPT_CD, ACST_NO, GATE_NO, ARCFT_STGCP, BDPSG_CNT, TRNS_BDPSG_CNT, CRSL_NO, ARCFT_SUBTYPE_CD, IRR_FLT_YN, TDFLT_YN, FRST_RGTR_ID, FRST_RGTR_IP_ADDR, FRST_REG_DT ) WITH AJMT AS (
) SELECT #{rsrcNo}, X.DOM_INTL_SE_CD, X.ARR_DEP_SE_CD, X.TMNL_ID, X.ALN_CD, X.FLTNM, X.DEP_ARR_YMD, X.DEP_ARR_HM, X.PREDC_HM, X.ACTL_HM, X.ARPT_CD, X.ACST_NO, X.GATE_NO, X.ARCFT_STGCP, NVL(X.BDPSG_CNT, 0) + ROUND( CASE WHEN X.ARR_DEP_SE_CD = 'D' AND X.DOM_INTL_SE_CD != 'D' THEN GREATEST(NVL(X.BDPSG_CNT, 0) - NVL(X.TRNS_BDPSG_CNT, 0), 0) ELSE 0 END * X.AJMT_RT / 100 ), X.TRNS_BDPSG_CNT, X.CRSL_NO, X.ARCFT_SUBTYPE_CD, X.IRR_FLT_YN, X.TDFLT_YN, #{loginUserId}, #{loginIpAddr}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM ( SELECT A.DOM_INTL_SE_CD, A.ARR_DEP_SE_CD, A.TMNL_ID, A.ALN_CD, A.FLTNM, A.GD_SE_YMD AS DEP_ARR_YMD, A.SCHDL_HM AS DEP_ARR_HM, A.PREDC_HM, A.ACTL_HM, A.ARPT_CD, A.ACST_NO, A.GATE_NO, A.ARCFT_STGCP, TO_NUMBER(TRIM(A.RSVT_BDPSG_CNT)) AS BDPSG_CNT, TO_NUMBER(TRIM(A.RSVT_TRNS_BDPSG_CNT)) AS TRNS_BDPSG_CNT, A.CRSL_NO, A.ARCFT_SUBTYPE_CD, A.GD_IRR_YN AS IRR_FLT_YN, A.TDFLT_YN, NVL(( SELECT NVL(F.AJMT_RT, 0) FROM AJMT F WHERE F.TMNL_ID = DECODE(A.TMNL_ID, 'P01', 'P01', 'P02', 'P01', 'P03', 'P03') ), 0) AS AJMT_RT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY A.ARR_DEP_SE_CD, A.FLTNM, A.GD_SE_YMD, A.SCHDL_HM ORDER BY A.RSVT_BDPSG_CNT DESC NULLS LAST ) AS RN FROM GOOWN.TN_GO_GD_DATA A WHERE A.GD_SE_YMD = #{excnYmd} AND A.CSHR_STTS_CD != 'SL' AND A.DLY_RSN_CD NOT IN ('2', '3') AND A.TMNL_ID IN ('P', 'P01', 'P02', 'P03') AND A.ARCFT_USE_SE_CD = '0' AND A.GD_FLT_PRPS_CD IN ('00', '05') AND A.PSG_CGO_SE_CD = 'Y' AND A.FRY_YN = 'N' AND A.LCRFT_YN = 'N' AND A.SCHDL_HM IS NOT NULL ) X WHERE X.RN = 1

/* CastUserSnapshotMapper.insertSchdlAtrbFromSrc */ INSERT INTO PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_SCHDL_ATRB ( SCHDL_ATRB_GROUP_ID, DOM_INTL_SE_CD, ARR_DEP_SE_CD, TMNL_ID, ALN_CD, ALN_CTGRY, FLTNM, DALY_FLTSH_ID, DEP_ARR_YMD, DEP_ARR_HM, PREDC_HM, ACTL_HM, ARR_DEP_ARPT_CD, ACST_NO, GATE_NO, GATE_TYPE, ARCFT_STGCP, BDPSG_CNT, TRNS_BDPSG_CNT, CRSL_NO, ARCFT_SUBTYPE_CD, CKNCT_RANGE_CN, SLF_CHKN_PSBLTY_YN, IRR_FLT_YN, TDFLT_YN, BUS_NEED_YN, WAYO_ID, FRST_BAG_INPUT_DT, LAST_BAG_INPUT_DT, FRST_RGTR_ID, FRST_RGTR_IP_ADDR, FRST_REG_DT ) WITH AJMT AS (
) SELECT #{rsrcNo}, A.DOM_INTL_SE_CD, A.ARR_DEP_SE_CD, A.TMNL_ID, A.ALN_CD, A.ALN_CTGRY, A.FLTNM, A.DALY_FLTSH_ID, A.DEP_ARR_YMD, A.DEP_ARR_HM, A.PREDC_HM, A.ACTL_HM, A.ARR_DEP_ARPT_CD, A.ACST_NO, A.GATE_NO, A.GATE_TYPE, A.ARCFT_STGCP, NVL(A.BDPSG_CNT, 0) + ROUND( CASE WHEN A.ARR_DEP_SE_CD = 'D' AND A.DOM_INTL_SE_CD != 'D' THEN GREATEST(NVL(A.BDPSG_CNT, 0) - NVL(A.TRNS_BDPSG_CNT, 0), 0) ELSE 0 END * NVL(( SELECT NVL(F.AJMT_RT, 0) FROM AJMT F WHERE F.TMNL_ID = DECODE(A.TMNL_ID, 'P01', 'P01', 'P02', 'P01', 'P03', 'P03') ), 0) / 100 ), A.TRNS_BDPSG_CNT, A.CRSL_NO, A.ARCFT_SUBTYPE_CD, A.CKNCT_RANGE_CN, A.SLF_CHKN_PSBLTY_YN, A.IRR_FLT_YN, A.TDFLT_YN, A.BUS_NEED_YN, A.WAYO_ID, A.FRST_BAG_INPUT_DT, A.LAST_BAG_INPUT_DT, #{loginUserId}, #{loginIpAddr}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_SCHDL_ATRB A WHERE A.SCHDL_ATRB_GROUP_ID = REPLACE(#{srcFltSchdlRsrcId}, 'FS', '')

/* CastUserSnapshotMapper.insertScrtyCntrlAtrb */ INSERT INTO PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_FCLTY_OPNG_SCRTY_CNTRL_ATRB ( SCRTY_CNTRL_ATRB_ID, FCLTY_OPNG_SN, TMNL_ID, FCLT_SE_CD, GATE_NO, FCLTY_CNT, FRST_RGTR_ID, FRST_RGTR_IP_ADDR, FRST_REG_DT ) WITH DPTGT AS (
) SELECT #{rsrcNo}, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY D.TMNL_ID, D.DPTGT_NO), D.TMNL_ID, 'D', D.DPTGT_NO, D.SCSH_CNTOM, #{loginUserId}, #{loginIpAddr}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM DPTGT D WHERE D.OPER_YN = 'Y' AND D.SCSH_CNTOM > 0

/* CastUserSnapshotMapper.insertEntcnyAtrb */ INSERT INTO PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_FCLTY_OPNG_ENTCNY_ATRB ( ENTCNY_ATRB_ID, FCLTY_OPNG_SN, TMNL_ID, FCLT_SE_CD, FCLTY_TYPE_ID, PSPRT, ENTCNY_TYPE_CD, FCLTY_CNT, FRST_RGTR_ID, FRST_RGTR_IP_ADDR, FRST_REG_DT ) SELECT #{rsrcNo}, A.FCLTY_OPNG_SN, A.TMNL_ID, A.FCLT_SE_CD, A.FCLTY_TYPE_ID, A.PSPRT, A.ENTCNY_TYPE_CD, A.FCLTY_CNT, #{loginUserId}, #{loginIpAddr}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_FCLTY_OPNG_ENTCNY_ATRB A WHERE A.ENTCNY_ATRB_ID = REGEXP_REPLACE(#{srcFcltyOpngEntcnyRsrcId}, 'FOTI|FacilityOpeningTable_Immigration', '')

/* CastUserSnapshotMapper.insertTrnstScrtyCntrlAtrb */ INSERT INTO PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_FCLTY_OPNG_TRNST_SCRTY_CNTRL_ATRB ( TRNST_SCRTY_CNTRL_ATRB_ID, FCLTY_OPNG_SN, TMNL_ID, FCLT_SE_CD, FCLTY_TYPE_ID, FCLTY_CNT, FRST_RGTR_ID, FRST_RGTR_IP_ADDR, FRST_REG_DT ) SELECT #{rsrcNo}, A.FCLTY_OPNG_SN, A.TMNL_ID, A.FCLT_SE_CD, A.FCLTY_TYPE_ID, A.FCLTY_CNT, #{loginUserId}, #{loginIpAddr}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_FCLTY_OPNG_TRNST_SCRTY_CNTRL_ATRB A WHERE A.TRNST_SCRTY_CNTRL_ATRB_ID = REGEXP_REPLACE(#{srcFcltyOpngTrScrtyCntrlRsrcId}, 'FOTTSC|FacilityOpeningTable_TransferSecurityControl', '')
